SELECT targetType, targetId, postId, boardId, boardName, preview, createdAt FROM ( SELECT 'post' AS targetType, p.post_id AS targetId, p.post_id AS postId, b.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, LEFT(p.content, 30) AS preview, MAX(r.created_at) AS createdAt FROM reports_log r INNER JOIN posts p ON r.target_type = 'post' AND r.target_id = p.post_id INNER JOIN boards b ON p.board_id = b.board_id GROUP BY p.post_id, b.board_id, b.name, LEFT(p.content, 30) UNION ALL SELECT 'comment' AS targetType, c.comment_id AS targetId, p2.post_id AS postId, b.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, LEFT(c.content, 30) AS preview, MAX(r.created_at) AS createdAt FROM reports_log r INNER JOIN comments c ON r.target_type = 'comment' AND r.target_id = c.comment_id INNER JOIN posts p2 ON c.post_id = p2.post_id INNER JOIN boards b ON p2.board_id = b.board_id GROUP BY c.comment_id, p2.post_id, b.board_id, b.name, LEFT(c.content, 30) ) recent ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT user_id AS userId, member_type AS memberType, login_id AS loginId, name, created_at AS joinedAt FROM users WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ban_status <> 'permanent' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
